column1: # Where every field of the lane's record files goes in the lane's database (bench/lane_db/migrations/). First tier.
# Columns: source <TAB> path prefix <TAB> action <TAB> target <TAB> note
# A field path is covered by the LONGEST prefix that equals it or is followed by '.' or '['. A key that is data is
# collapsed first: a subject's label to <subject>, a number to <n>, a frame span to <span>. The importer refuses a
# record with a path no line covers (bench/lane_db/cover.py), so a new field needs a line here before it imports.
#   col      a typed column: target is table.column
#   child    rows of a child table: target is the table
#   said_by  who said or wrote it: a said_by / by column of the row
#   history  an earlier state: rows the standing one superseded
#   artifact a file: a location (root + relative path) and, where the record gives a sha256, an artifact
#   view     derived from another source: not stored twice
#   meta     about the file, not the record (schema tags, the video name): checked, not stored
#   raw      kept only in import_source.raw, verbatim and traceable; no tool reads it
#   ask      the owner has not ruled: target holds the recommended action, which a scratch build takes; a build of the
#            lane's own file is refused while any line is `ask`
# Not in the first tier, and so not here yet: review/items.json, verdicts/verdicts.jsonl (a view of the answers but
# for its lines from a terminal), picks_against_answers.jsonl, the job and preview files, the capture manifests.
